stories.title: Dual-purpose qubit design could speed operations while cutting quantum errors
stories.desc: Researchers from MIT have designed a new qubit architecture that enables qubits to interact with each other much more quickly while remaining very stable. This advance could someday help scientists build practical quantum computers that can run long, complex algorithms with high accuracy.
